title: SB1708 (113th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 39, Chapter 17, Part 13; Title 49, Chapter 1 and Title 49, Chapter 50, relative to private schools.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Chaptered, 2024-04-26; official copy via the Internet Archive snapshot 20260514152713 of https://publications.tnsosfiles.com/acts/113/pub/pc0738.pdf (LegiScan doc 2990767))
provenance.note: Public Chapter 738, signed 2024-04-26 (the House bill's print; the Senate bill was substituted). Widens the private-school handgun carry policy in 49-50-803 and the 39-17-1309(e)(9) exemption from K-12 to pre-K-12 schools. The text does not print the handgun carry policy itself; the quoted sections change its wording only. Quote spaces "§ 49-6-3001(c)" cleanly; the OCR text prints "§ 49-6-3001 (c)". Text is the House bill print (Senate bill was substituted).

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (TCA 49-50-803): is amended by deleting "K-12" wherever it appears in the section.
SECTION 2 (TCA 49-50-803, new subsection (f)): (f) As used in this section, "private school" means a private school as defined in § 49-6-3001(c) that serves students in any of the grades pre-kindergarten through twelve (pre-K-12).
SECTION 3 (TCA 39-17-1309(e)(9)): is amended by deleting "K-12".
